page.layout: One printed page, title page, centred text block; no margins with text; show-through of the reverse page visible faintly and not transcribed.
page.notes: Title page, no page number, running head, catchword or signature printed. Show-through from the reverse side (faint outlines of text, e.g. a line reading "IN MISCELLANEA CATHOLICA") is not transcribed. Fine-letter display type; "Heterodoxos" and "perspi-" follow the print, with the hyphen at the line end.
